method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Electronic Transactions Act 1999 (Cth), Compilation No. 4 (register id C2026C00011), compilation date 5 December 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00553.txt (retrieved 13 October 2026). Electronic Transactions Regulations not deposited: s 7A exemptions and s 12 data-storage-device requirements are inputs.
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the contracting party: ss 7A, 7B(1) (exemptions, as inputs); s 9(1) writing; s 10(1), (3) signature; s 11(1), (3), (5) and Schedule 1 production; s 12(1), (2), (4) recording and retention; s 14(1) dispatch; s 14A(1), (2) receipt; s 15(1), (2) attribution; Part 2A ss 15A(2), 15B, 15C, 15D(2)-(3), with s 17(3). Not encoded: permissions (ss 9(2), 11(2)), laws with their own IT rules, copyright, s 14B place, s 15E-15F, machinery. The WA Electronic Transactions Act 2011 is not encoded.
lives: daniel d045 (2031-07-10): standard terms for the software, electronic acceptance -- is a click acceptance?
